statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Extreme geopolitical and cross-asset stress persists, but a sufficiently fresh current-hour NQ one-way path is not verified.
recommendation: Current conditions map to WATCH; Tail remains below the blocking threshold while current evidence is dominated by oil, yields and Asian risk-off pressure rather than verified persistent NQ mean-reversion failure.
headline: Extreme cross-asset stress with Tail still at WATCH
body: Asian equities are sharply lower, Brent is above $95 and the U.S. 10-year yield is near 4.81% as U.S.-Iran hostilities intensify. S&P 500 e-mini futures were slightly lower in Reuters' latest Asia update. Direct NQ evidence for the current clock hour is not sufficiently fresh, so Tail remains below the blocking threshold.

lookbackSummary: Tail rose from low/watch conditions early on September 1 into elevated/high levels during the U.S. session, peaked at 47% in the 19:00 UTC slot, then returned to WATCH overnight as the price path became more two-sided and current NQ evidence became less complete.
outlookSummary: The base path remains WATCH overnight. Conditional Tail risk rises around ADP, the U.S. cash open, Factory Orders/EIA, the Beige Book and Broadcom; later verified checkpoints include Waller, ISM Services, the September 4 Employment Situation and September 8 Consumer Credit.

forecast.analysis: Asian equities remain sharply lower while oil and long yields stay elevated. Direct NQ evidence for this clock hour is not sufficiently fresh, so Tail stays at WATCH unless repeated extension and shallow rebounds become observable.
drivers: No verified current-hour NQ one-way path

news.title: Asian markets tumble as US-Iran fighting lifts oil and bond yields
Oil up nearly 1% as US and Iran trade fresh strikes

forecast.analysis: Late-Asia conditions remain high-stress. Tail stays at WATCH if U.S. futures remain two-sided; renewed low-holding with failed rebounds would be the main route into an elevated band.
drivers: Two-sided U.S. futures as base case
Low-holding or failed rebounds as escalation

forecast.analysis: With no major U.S. release in this hour, the base path assumes partial absorption of the oil-and-yield shock. A fresh geopolitical discontinuity or persistent NQ extension would invalidate the modest easing.

Pre-Europe risk remains dominated by oil, yields and conflict headlines rather than verified NQ mean-reversion failure. Stable futures would keep Tail below blocking; synchronized deterioration would raise it.
Europe's cash open can transmit the bond-and-oil shock back into U.S. futures. Tail remains at WATCH unless NQ confirms the move through shallow pullbacks, repeated extension or extreme-holding.
Early European follow-through is the key checkpoint. Sustained cross-asset weakness plus NQ extreme-holding would lift Tail; rotation away from extremes would keep the regime in WATCH.
Mid-European trade is less event-dense. Two-sided NQ structure would allow Tail to ease, while a second geopolitical information wave could re-intensify the directional risk.
Risk should soften if Europe stabilizes and yields stop extending. Tail would re-escalate only if U.S. futures begin holding an extreme with repeated failed retracements.

The U.S. pre-data window becomes more headline-sensitive as ADP approaches. Event importance lifts Stress, while Tail remains below blocking unless a persistent directional path is already developing.
drivers: Persistent directional path required for Tail escalation

forecast.analysis: ADP at 12:15 UTC is a high-volatility checkpoint. The elevated Tail forecast is conditional on a release-driven move that persists with shallow retracements; orderly two-sided price discovery would imply lower realized Tail.

The U.S. cash open at 13:30 UTC is the strongest structural checkpoint. Tail is highest if the opening auction aligns with the earlier shock and NQ holds near an extreme; rapid rotation would invalidate the elevated path.

Factory Orders at 14:00 UTC and EIA petroleum data at 14:30 UTC create a second information cluster. Elevated Tail requires directional follow-through across NQ, yields and oil rather than event volatility alone.
After the data cluster, Tail remains elevated only if the market fails to mean-revert and extends the opening move. A recovery toward the middle of the intraday range would support a quick downgrade.

By mid-session, the base path assumes some absorption of the morning information. Tail falls back to WATCH if retracements are meaningful and cross-assets stabilize; repeated extension would invalidate that decay.
The afternoon lull is lower-risk in the base case, but geopolitical headlines can still interrupt stabilization. Tail remains below blocking absent renewed one-way NQ efficiency.
drivers: Renewed one-way NQ efficiency as escalation

forecast.analysis: The Beige Book at 18:00 UTC can reprice rate expectations. Elevated Tail is conditional on a rates-driven equity move that persists after the release; a brief volatility spike without extension would remain mainly Stress.
drivers: Federal Reserve Beige Book at 18:00 UTC

forecast.analysis: The first post-Beige-Book hour carries delayed rates-reaction risk. Tail stays only modestly elevated unless yields and NQ remain directionally aligned after an attempted retracement.
Late cash-session risk eases if the Beige Book reaction is absorbed. Broadcom's after-close report remains a later catalyst, but it is not treated as already-known news or as automatic Tail evidence.
drivers: No automatic Tail escalation from scheduled events

forecast.analysis: Broadcom's after-close results create a concentrated Nasdaq catalyst. Elevated Tail is conditional on a large index-transmitted move with poor retracement; the scheduled event itself does not establish direction.
drivers: Broadcom reports after the U.S. close
Poor retracement required for elevated Tail

forecast.analysis: Broadcom's 21:00 UTC conference call can add a second information wave after the initial release. Tail is elevated if guidance-driven repricing extends without meaningful pullback; two-sided digestion would lower it.
The post-call hour tests whether any Broadcom move persists into futures. Tail stays elevated only if the move continues with shallow pullbacks and broader tech confirmation.
Late-evening Tail decays toward the threshold if post-earnings price discovery becomes two-sided. Continued one-way technology pressure would keep the elevated forecast in force.
Overnight conditions should normalize if Broadcom and macro reactions are absorbed. Tail returns to WATCH unless fresh conflict news or persistent futures extension reopens the directional risk.
drivers: Fresh conflict or persistent extension as escalation

forecast.analysis: The final forecast hour remains WATCH ahead of the next U.S. data cycle. Risk is still headline-sensitive, but no later event outcome is assumed and no future price path is presented as observed.
drivers: Next U.S. data cycle remains ahead
